issue: Password is not verified at sign-in; any password grants a session
actual: Registered qa_alpha@example.com with password 'secret123', signed out, then signed in using password 'wrongpassword999'. The app redirected to the home page and the nav showed the logged-in state (nav.profile = 'qa_tester_alpha', nav.logout present) instead of rejecting the credentials.
evidence: POST login with incorrect password -> URL http://localhost:7019/ and nav snapshot: navigation[nav.new-thread, nav.profile 'qa_tester_alpha'], action[nav.logout]

Registered qa_tester_alpha / qa_alpha@example.com / 'secret123' (9 chars) -> redirected to home, nav showed nav.profile 'qa_tester_alpha' + nav.logout. Duplicate username (qa_tester_alpha + new email) and duplicate email (new username + qa_alpha@example.com) both stayed on /register with no account created or session started. Signed out then signed back in with the same credentials -> logged-in state restored. Note: duplicate rejections give no visible error text (silent), though the rejection itself is correct.

Edit Profile -> set bio 'QA engineer who loves testing forums.' and interests 'Testing, Automation, Coffee' -> Save. Profile card then shows profile.bio = 'QA engineer who loves testing forums.' and profile.interests rendered as separate chips Testing / Automation / Coffee (comma-separated string parsed correctly).

issue: Missing/blank fields are silently rejected; no validation message identifies the missing information
actual: Submitting the fully empty New Thread form left the page at /new-thread with no thread created, but the form text contained no error or field-level message. Repeating with category=Technology and whitespace-only title ('   ') and body ('   ') also blocked creation yet again showed no message — form text remained 'Category ... Title 0/200 ... Content Cancel Create Thread' with no indication of which fields were invalid.
evidence: Empty submit -> form innerText has no error string; whitespace submit -> still /new-thread, title counter '3/200', no error node anywhere in the form region.

Created thread with category=Technology, title 'QA Alpha Zebra Thread about testing', body 'This is the body of the QA alpha thread...'. Redirected to /thread/thread-1787888348120 showing thread.title, thread.content, category badge 'Technology', author qa_tester_alpha, 0 replies. It also appears in /category/tech listing alongside thread-7 and thread-1.

/category/tech listed only Technology threads (thread-7 'Building a mechanical keyboard', thread-1 'What programming language should I learn in 2024?', plus new thread-1787888348120). Switching to /category/gaming changed the result set to only thread-4 'Best indie games of 2023 that flew under the radar' (Gaming). Filtering is correct per category.

issue: Category and community counts are hardcoded placeholders; they neither match actual records nor update when records are created
actual: Only 9 threads exist in the forum (8 seeded + 1 created), yet stats.threads shows '1,045', stats.replies '4,823' and stats.members '892'. Category counts show Technology (243) while /category/tech lists just 3 threads, and Gaming (312) while /category/gaming lists exactly 1 thread. After registering a new member and publishing a new Technology thread, Technology remained (243), stats.threads remained 1,045 and stats.members remained 892 — no count updated.
evidence: Home: stats.threads=1,045 / stats.replies=4,823 / stats.members=892 vs 9 rendered thread rows. Category labels unchanged pre- and post-creation: General (156), Technology (243), Creative (89), Lifestyle (167), Gaming (312), News (78).

Search 'zebra' (lowercase) matched title 'QA Alpha Zebra Thread about testing' only -> case-insensitive title match. Search 'MENTIONS' (uppercase, word appears only in the body) returned the same single thread -> case-insensitive body match. Search 'qqzzxxnomatch123' returned 0 rows with clear feedback 'No threads found. Try adjusting your search terms.' and summary 'Showing results for "qqzzxxnomatch123"'.

On /thread/thread-1, reply.submit was disabled while reply.content was empty (blocks empty replies). Typed 'QA reply from alpha tester - checking reply counts.' and clicked Post Reply: new node thread.replies.item.reply-1787888433619 rendered without any reload (listed replies 2 -> 3) and thread.reply-count changed from '23 replies' to '24 replies' (+1).

issue: Displayed reply total does not match the number of replies actually listed on the detail view
actual: /thread/thread-1 displayed '23 replies' while its detail view listed only 2 reply items (reply-1, reply-2). After posting a reply the header read '24 replies' but only 3 replies are listed. The seeded totals are inflated placeholders, so the displayed total and the listed replies disagree by 21 on this thread (other seeded threads show the same pattern, e.g. thread-6 '89 replies').
evidence: thread.reply-count='23 replies' vs 2 rendered reply nodes; after adding one reply: '24 replies' vs 3 rendered nodes. Increment is consistent (+1) but absolute totals never match.

On thread-1 (authored by TechExplorer, another user): clicking thread.upvote raised thread.upvotes 47 -> 48 immediately and applied selected styling (bg-primary/10 text-primary); clicking again removed it, 48 -> 47 with selected styling cleared — confirming a single toggleable vote rather than repeated increments. Clicking thread.replies.item.reply-1.upvote raised reply upvotes 15 -> 16 with selected state true. All updates rendered immediately with no reload.

From thread-1, clicking thread.author opened /profile/user-1 showing username 'TechExplorer', join date 'Joined about 3 years ago', reputation '2,450 reputation', bio 'Full-stack developer passionate about open source...', interests chips (Programming, Open Source, AI/ML, DevOps) and 'Threads by TechExplorer (2)' listing both authored discussions. From a reply, clicking thread.replies.item.reply-1.author opened /profile/user-3 (GameMaster42) with the same complete field set including 'Threads by GameMaster42 (1)'.

Most Active initial order by reply count: 89, 67, 45, 41, 38, 34(thread-5), 31(thread-3), 24, 0 — strictly descending. Added 4 replies to thread-3 (31 -> 35). Re-opening Most Active gave 89, 67, 45, 41, 38, 35(thread-3), 34(thread-5), 24, 0 — thread-3 correctly overtook thread-5, so the ordering re-ranks with reply activity.

Trending order by upvotes: 156, 124, 92, 89, 78, 67, 56, 47, 0 (thread-...575010), 0 (thread-...348120) — strictly descending. Upvoting the last thread (348120) moved it from position 10 to position 9 with 1 upvote, ahead of 575010 at 0, so the ranking updates immediately when voting changes it.

issue: No recent time window is stated or applied; Trending/Most Active rank by all-time totals
actual: The browse filters are only 'Trending / Recent / Most Active' and the headings are 'Trending Discussions' / 'Most Active Discussions' — nowhere is a time window such as 'this week' or 'past 24 hours' stated (page text contains no window phrase). Ranking is by lifetime totals, not interactions in a window: the Trending list is topped by seeded threads that the profile pages date 'over 2 years ago' (thread-6 at 156 upvotes, thread-1 'over 2 years ago'), while threads created today rank last. Most Active likewise sorts on cumulative reply counts (89, 67, 45, ...) regardless of when those replies occurred.
evidence: browse.filters innerText = 'Trending\nRecent\nMost Active'; threads.heading = 'Trending Discussions'; search.summary = 'Join the conversation with our community'; no date-window string in document text. Trending top entries are 2-year-old seeded threads ranked by all-time upvotes.

issue: Unauthenticated access to discussion creation renders a blank dead-end page instead of a sign-in screen
actual: While logged out there is no 'New Thread' affordance anywhere (header shows only 'ThreadHive / Login / Register' and no create-thread CTA exists on the page). Navigating to the creation route /new-thread as an unauthenticated user renders a completely empty page: document.body.innerText is '' and #root contains only an empty notifications section (body HTML 256 chars), still at /new-thread after a 1.5s wait. There is no redirect to sign-in, no login form, no message, and therefore no way to authenticate and return to discussion creation.
evidence: Logged-out /new-thread -> semantic_snapshot returned no elements at all ({"screen":"new-thread"} with zero groups); body text empty and stable after delay.

issue: No persistence whatsoever; a page reload wipes all accounts, sessions, content and votes back to seed data
actual: After a page reload the app reset entirely to its seeded state. The registered account qa_tester_alpha was gone and the session was lost (header shows 'ThreadHive / Login / Register'). Both authored discussions disappeared — the thread list returned to exactly the 8 seeded threads with 'QA Alpha Zebra Thread about testing' and 'QA Beta Thread for trending rank test' absent. Replies were lost: thread-1 reverted from '24 replies' to '23 replies' and thread-3 from '35 replies' to '31 replies'. Vote state was lost: thread-...348120's upvote vanished with the thread, and all seeded upvote counts reverted to their originals. localStorage was completely empty ({}), confirming nothing is stored. Saved profile bio/interests were also unrecoverable.
evidence: Post-reload: 8 threads only; thread-1 23 replies / thread-3 31 replies (pre-reload 24 / 35); Object.keys(localStorage) = [] ; header unauthenticated.

In one loaded session as qa_session_user: saved bio 'Session persistence tester bio.' + interests (Sessions, Persistence), created 'Session Persistence Check Thread' (Creative Corner), replied to thread-2 (45 -> 46 replies) and upvoted thread-2 (89 -> 90, selected). After logging out and logging back in with the same credentials WITHOUT reloading: header showed qa_session_user, profile still showed the bio, both interest chips and 'Threads by qa_session_user (1)' with the authored thread; thread-2 still showed '46 replies', '90' upvotes and the upvote button still in the selected state. All profile details, authored discussions, replies and vote state remained intact.
